description: This file contains utility functions for handling network requests, proxy configuration, server creation, and URL availability checks within the Playwright core project. It includes functions for making HTTP/HTTPS requests, creating servers, and managing proxies, with specific focus on network operations and server management.

methods.name: httpRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP/HTTPS request with support for redirects, proxy, and timeout.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches data from a URL with optional progress tracking and error handling.

methods.name: createProxyAgent
methods.description: Creates a proxy agent based on provided proxy settings and target URL.

methods.name: createHttpServer
methods.description: Creates an HTTP server with optional request listener.

methods.name: createHttpsServer
methods.description: Creates an HTTPS server with optional request listener.

methods.name: createHttp2Server
methods.description: Creates an HTTP/2 secure server with optional request handler.

methods.name: startHttpServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server listening on specified host and port.

methods.name: isURLAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a URL is available and returns a boolean.

methods.name: decorateServer
methods.description: Decorates a server to manage socket connections and ensure proper cleanup on close.
